overview_description.description: Mendel offers a corporate expense management platform that streamlines financial processes for businesses. Its solutions include automated expense tracking, corporate cards, and real-time reporting to improve visibility and control over company spending. The platform integrates with accounting systems and provides analytics for better financial decision-making.
